text.name: Defence of Kyiv
text.rules: Record "the capital holds". LIO spends 2 points on one action. If LIO played this card, until the end of this turn, each time SAE spends points, it spends 1 fewer, never below 1. At the end of this turn, LIO spends 1 point on actions. If this card's event happens, remove it from the game afterwards.
text.history: Russian forces advancing from the north in the first days of the invasion of 24 February 2022 were stopped short of Kyiv, where a military convoy about 60 kilometres long stalled; by early April 2022 Russia had withdrawn from the whole Kyiv region.
